Example: CAGR calculation

Using these inputs:

  • Solve for: Growth rate (CAGR)
  • Beginning value: $10,000
  • Ending value: $25,000
  • Years: 7

The calculator returns:

  • CAGR: +13.99% (per year, compounded)
  • Total return: +150%
  • Gain: +$15,000
  • Growth multiple: 2.5×
  • Doubling time: 5.3 years (At this rate)
